---
title: Flat numbering
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
number-sections: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    list-of: [fig]
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'Figure 3' && ! pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'Figure 1\.1'
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['typst-extras-list-of\(']
        - ['#typst-extras-reset-chapter\(\(', '#let typst-extras-config =', 'typst-extras-wrap\(equation-numbering']
---
